why: BD-R2 (Bob, 8 Nov): process3 is product-neutral. Each entry is the sha256 of a lower-cased product term (a word or hyphen-joined words), never the term: add one with node tool/deny-add.mjs <term>. tool/test/product-neutral.test.mjs hashes every word and hyphen-joined phrase in tool/, rulebooks/, governing/, shims/, setup/ and README.md and fails on a match. notes/ and DECISIONS.md are history and are not scanned.
